title: Growth Hacking for Small Businesses: Practical Guide | Iskali

facts.fact: The vendor Iskali advertises a free 45-minute revenue leak diagnosis.
Iskali lists its phone line hours as Monday to Friday 8:30 to 5:00 and Saturday 8:30 to 1:00, Pacific Time.
The guide was last updated on November 3, 2026.
The page presents its experiment cycle as a six-step process, ending with measuring and deciding.
facts.quote: 6.  **Measure and decide.** If it works, it becomes a process.
